graphEvents.label: Missing related sections in two references

label: runner-contract.md and quality-config.md end without a Related Resources section, while only code-style-guide.md closes with one, so two of three quality references leave the reader with no next step.
runner-contract.md has single prose lines of 1,296 (53), 780 (55), 971 (103), 1,657 (113) and 815 (118) characters, rendering as unbroken paragraph walls that hide the option-to-effect mapping.
quality-config.md's entire OVERVIEW is one 121-word paragraph with no Purpose and no When to Use, so scope and applicability are buried in the first block.
code-style-guide.md packs rule id, rationale and a before/after pair into one 408-character paragraph at line 116 instead of the template's code-block example.
